title: Ceremony Arches & Garlands
description: Ceremony installations from several weddings — an organic garland climbing a timber cross in sage, gold, and blush; the same cross reworked in purple and lavender wisteria; and a freestanding hoop arch with sheer draping and oversized paper poppies set among the pines.

alt./photos/hero/church-garland-arch.jpg: A sage-green, gold, and white organic balloon garland arcing over a wooden cross at a stone-walled venue
alt./photos/services/balloons-purple-wisteri: A purple and lavender organic balloon garland with wisteria accents arcing over a wooden cross at a stone-walled venue
alt./photos/services/officiating-ceremony-ar: A wooden circular ceremony arch with sheer draping and oversized poppy flowers, set against a stone building and pine forest
alt.purple-wisteria-hoop-arch.jpg: A purple, lavender, and white organic balloon hoop with wisteria trails, set against a patterned backdrop
